description: The Operations Dashboard gives leadership a real-time view of operational health by measuring fulfillment volume, revenue efficiency, technician productivity, margin performance, and service disruption rates. It is intended to support better decisions around staffing, scheduling, cost control, and execution quality.

The Marketing Dashboard provides a top-of-funnel view of demand generation performance by tracking visibility, traffic, lead volume, and acquisition efficiency across paid and non-paid channels. It measures how effectively marketing spend converts impressions into clicks and clicks into leads, while also separating Google-sourced leads from non-Google leads to show channel mix and dependency. The dashboard is designed to help the team evaluate campaign reach, traffic quality, cost efficiency, and lead acquisition performance so they can optimize spend, improve funnel efficiency, and scale demand more profitably.
